_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it. Empty history = nothing used yet.

elements.desc: the hook: 2-3 centred lines in the chest band, one on a red/maroon block, on from frame 0, ~5 s
0.6 s grainy swipe on every B-roll cut: blur whip, yellow, cyan brush on white, blue, orange, iris open; one whoosh
two-tier label on each B-roll insert: big white line + small line on a maroon block; glitches out with the swipe
1-2 big white lines tilted -6 deg over the chest, each revealed left to right on its spoken onset
orange speech bubble + LINE badge + white handle pill, from ~60 % to the end card, gentle float
small white top chrome: stacked caps tagline left, wordmark right, whole reel
silent white logo card, wordmark fades and rises in
